mutants.description: CapabilityGrantVerifier.verify no longer rejects a capability whose signed agent_id differs from the authenticated request agent.
mutants.target_invariant: A capability authorises only the agent it is bound to.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Request with a validly signed capability for another agent must be DENY (CAPABILITY_AGENT_MISMATCH).

mutants.description: CapabilityGrantVerifier.verify no longer rejects a capability bound to a different session.
mutants.target_invariant: A capability authorises only the session it is bound to.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Request presenting another session's capability must be DENY (CAPABILITY_SESSION_MISMATCH).

mutants.description: CapabilityGrantVerifier.verify no longer requires the requested tool to be in allowed_tools.
mutants.target_invariant: A capability authorises only tools listed exactly in allowed_tools.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Request for a tool outside the capability scope must be DENY (CAPABILITY_TOOL_MISMATCH).

mutants.description: CapabilityGrantVerifier.verify no longer rejects capabilities with now >= expires_at.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Request with an expired capability must be DENY (CAPABILITY_EXPIRED).

mutants.description: CapabilityGrantVerifier.verify no longer rejects capabilities with now < issued_at.
mutants.target_invariant: A capability is not valid before issued_at.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Request with a not-yet-valid capability must be DENY (CAPABILITY_NOT_YET_VALID).

mutants.description: ApprovalGrantVerifier.verifyV2 no longer compares the signed tool with the pending action's tool.
mutants.target_invariant: An approval authorises only the tool of the pending action it was issued for.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Validly signed grant for a different tool must be REJECT and must not execute the pending action.
reachability_path: ApprovalGrantVerifier.verifyV2 with trusted context from the pending action

mutants.description: ApprovalGrantVerifier.verifyV2 no longer compares the approver claim with the pending action's configured approver.
mutants.target_invariant: Only the configured approver claim can resolve a pending action.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Validly signed grant naming another approver must be REJECT.
reachability_path: ApprovalGrantVerifier.verifyV2 with trusted context from the pending action

mutants.description: GuardedExecutor.resolveApproval no longer expires pending actions after ask_details.timeout_seconds.
mutants.target_invariant: A pending action cannot be approved after its timeout.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Approval after the pending timeout must be REJECT and must not execute.
reachability_path: GuardedExecutor.process (ASK creates pending action at clock t0)

mutants.description: GuardedExecutor.resolveApproval no longer rejects grants with issued_at before the ASK was created.
mutants.target_invariant: An approval cannot predate the decision it approves.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Grant with issued_at < ASK creation must be REJECT.

mutants.description: GuardedExecutor.resolveApproval no longer rejects grants issued too far in the future.
mutants.target_invariant: Approval issued_at may not exceed now + approvalFutureSkewMs.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Grant with excessive future issued_at must be REJECT.

mutants.description: ReplayGuard.check no longer rejects a duplicate request_id within a session.
mutants.target_invariant: A request_id is accepted at most once per session.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Duplicate request in the same session must be DENY (REPLAY_DETECTED) and must not execute again.

mutants.description: ReplayGuard.check no longer rejects timestamps outside the skew window.
mutants.target_invariant: Requests outside the freshness window are rejected.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Stale or future-skewed request must be DENY (TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_WINDOW).

mutants.description: GuardedExecutor ignores a Result Guardian DENY and delivers the raw tool output.
mutants.target_invariant: Result-policy DENY withholds the raw output.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Restricted output must be WITHHOLD, never DELIVER.
reachability_path: harness tool double returns corpus-defined restricted output

mutants.description: Pending approval authority (pendingActions.delete(key)) is consumed only after the asynchronous execution path instead of synchronously before the first await.
mutants.target_invariant: Duplicate concurrent approvals consume the pending authority at most once (consumption happens synchronously before the first asynchronous execution boundary).
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Two or more concurrent duplicate approvals execute the pending action exactly once.
reachability_path: N concurrent GuardedExecutor.resolveApproval calls started without awaiting
each passes pending lookup + verifyV2 synchronously
pendingActions.delete(key) placement relative to await executeAndProcessResult

mutants.description: ApprovalGrantVerifier.verifyV2 no longer compares grant.request_id with the trusted expected request.
mutants.target_invariant: verifyV2 rejects a grant whose request_id differs from the trusted context.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: verifyV2(grant for request A, context for request B) must REJECT.
mutants.runtime_unreachability: GuardedExecutor.resolveApproval looks up the pending action by `${grant.session_id}:${grant.request_id}` and builds the trusted context from that pending action, whose ids were stored under the same key. Pending ids are schema-validated UUIDs (no ':'), so no (session_id, request_id) pair different from the pending one can produce the same key; the verifier's request comparison therefore always sees equal values on the public runtime path.

mutants.description: ApprovalGrantVerifier.verifyV2 no longer compares grant.session_id with the trusted expected session.
mutants.target_invariant: verifyV2 rejects a grant whose session_id differs from the trusted context.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: verifyV2(grant for session A, context for session B) must REJECT.
mutants.runtime_unreachability: Same as M15: the pending lookup key embeds grant.session_id, and the trusted expected session is read from the pending action stored under that key, so the runtime path cannot present differing session values to verifyV2.

mutants.description: ExecutionGate.execute no longer removes a permit from #activePermits when it is used.
mutants.target_invariant: An execution permit authorises at most one execution.
mutants.expected_exposed_invariant: Presenting the same minted permit twice executes the tool at most once.
reachability_path: ExecutionGate.execute x N with the same permit
mutants.runtime_unreachability: GuardedExecutor mints a fresh permit inside executeAndProcessResult for every execution, passes it to ExecutionGate.execute exactly once and never exposes the permit or the private #permitAuthority symbol through its public API, so no public runtime call can present a used permit again.
